Method of Attack: Bypasses Microsoft Teams restrictions for incoming files from external users by exploiting client-side protections that treat external users as internal by changing the ID in the POST request of a message
Uploads attachment to sender's Sharepoint and sends phishing messages with Sharepoint attachment links to target Teams users
Automated attack that verifies target user existence and ability to receive external messages, then creates new thread and sends message with attachment link
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Business accounts with Teams and Sharepoint licenses
Attack Vector: Phishing messages with Sharepoint attachment links sent via Microsoft Teams
Manipulation of POST request ID to bypass file-sending restrictions
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing messages containing Sharepoint attachment links
Automated Teams threads appearing in sender's Teams interface
